## Outcome

Describe what knowledge becomes easier to understand, verify, or apply.

## Content class

- [ ] Verified fact
- [ ] Source-backed interpretation
- [ ] Practical experience
- [ ] Candidate method
- [ ] Inspiration

## Evidence and rights

- [ ] `python scripts/validate_repository.py` passes
- [ ] Time-sensitive claims use current primary or authoritative sources
- [ ] Quotes are short, attributed, and necessary
- [ ] No private, company, client, credential, paid-course, or unlicensed image material is included
- [ ] Relevant indexes and `CATALOG.md` were regenerated

## Change boundary

List the notes changed and the material intentionally left untouched.
